name: Cold open
description: Starts mid-story with one striking scene and one line, like a film's first shot; the offer arrives a scroll later.
layout: Full-bleed scene or photograph, one short line, small logo; nav quiet until scroll.
motion: Scene settles slowly, headline lands last; nothing else moves.
avoid_when: Transactional sites where visitors need the offer and price immediately.

name: Oversized statement
description: One sentence set huge and cropped at the edge, carrying the brand's point of view before any imagery.
layout: Display type across 10-12 columns, real product visual pushed below or to a small inset.
motion: Word or line split reveal once; the rest static.
avoid_when: Brands without a sharp one-line point of view; long product names.

name: Product in hand
description: The real product or interface fills the first screen at large size; the headline is small and precise beside it.
layout: 7/5 split or product bleeding off the edge; headline left-aligned, one primary action.
motion: Product clip-reveal or scroll-scrubbed rotation; copy arrives before the product settles.
avoid_when: Services with no tangible product; stock imagery standing in for the product.

name: Live evidence hero
description: Opens with a live or current number (tonnes diverted today, orders shipped this hour) that proves the promise.
layout: Number set in display size with a plain-language caption and source; secondary visual small.
motion: Count once to the real value; a small pulse when it updates.
avoid_when: No real data source; invented figures.

name: Two doors
description: The first screen splits into two clearly labelled paths for two audiences (buyers and sellers, patients and clinicians).
layout: Two halves or two large panels with equal weight; each leads to its own chapter sequence.
motion: Hovered door expands slightly; chosen path transitions with a view transition.
avoid_when: Single-audience brands; more than two audiences (use navigation instead).

name: Film poster open
description: A looping film still or short reel as the opening, framed like a poster; it may shrink and dock into the layout as the page scrolls.
layout: Full-bleed video with a pause control, title block in a corner like a poster credit.
motion: Video loops muted with a visible pause; title fades in after the first frame; optional scrubbed dock.
avoid_when: Slow networks as the main audience; brands without real footage.

name: Kinetic type moment
tags: kinetic typography|3d type|big text|brand name|wave text|type as image
description: Giant type bends, tilts or waves with scroll so the words become the image; one moment per site.
layout: Full-width display type, few words, high contrast; body text elsewhere stays conventional.
motion: Scrubbed 3D or wave transforms on split words; flattened on mobile and under reduced motion.
avoid_when: Civic, healthcare or finance brands; long words at 390 px.

name: Founder letter
description: A short letter from the founder in their own voice, signed, explaining why the company exists.
layout: Narrow text column (60-66ch), serif or handwriting accent, portrait small in the margin.
motion: Signature draws once when reached; paragraphs static.
avoid_when: Founder unwilling to be the face; corporate brands with many owners.

name: Origin timeline
description: The company's history as dated milestones along a line that draws as you scroll, each with an artifact or photo.
layout: Vertical line with alternating milestones, or a pinned horizontal rail on desktop.
motion: Line draws with scroll, milestones light up as passed.
avoid_when: Young companies with fewer than four meaningful milestones.

name: Then and now
description: Archive photographs paired with today's view of the same place, product or people.
layout: Paired images at identical aspect ratio with a caption line per pair.
motion: Scroll-scrubbed wipe from archive to present.
avoid_when: No archive material.

name: The first artifact
description: A macro view of the object that started it all (first sketch, first tool, first batch) with handwritten-style annotations.
layout: One large image with 3-5 callouts connected by thin leader lines.
motion: Zoom into the artifact, callouts draw in one by one.
avoid_when: Brands whose origin is not tied to an object.

name: Illustrated panels
description: The origin told as illustrated panels that appear and animate in sequence, so scrolling turns the pages.
layout: One panel per viewport on mobile, a pinned panel grid on desktop; captions set like speech or narration.
motion: Panels reveal and pan per step; characters animate with Lottie or Rive when available.
avoid_when: Brands without a consistent illustration hand; formal B2B audiences.

name: The problem, scaled
description: Makes the problem physical: one statistic grows until it fills the screen, then the brand's answer appears.
layout: Single number or shape that grows to full bleed; one sentence of context with a source.
motion: Scrubbed growth of the figure, then a hard cut to calm.
avoid_when: Positive-only brands (celebrations, gifts) where dwelling on a problem is off-tone.

name: Status quo vs our way
description: Shows the familiar frustrating way next to the brand's way, swapping one into the other as you scroll.
layout: Split frame or layered scene with a moving divider; short labels, no feature lists.
motion: Clip-path swap scrubbed by scroll; a range input for manual comparison.
avoid_when: When the comparison names competitors (legal risk) or is unfair.

name: Myths flipped
description: Common misconceptions set as statements that get struck out and corrected as you read.
layout: Large statements in a single column, correction set beneath in the accent voice.
motion: Strike-through wipes across, correction rises once.
avoid_when: Audiences who may feel mocked; sensitive health topics.

name: Manifesto
description: A few short lines of belief that brighten as they are read, the brand talking in its own voice.
layout: Large type, one idea per line, generous leading; full-width or offset column.
motion: Words brighten with scroll; optionally pinned chapters per belief.
avoid_when: Brands without a genuine point of view; utility products.

name: Interlude
description: One oversized line or quote between dense sections, giving the page a breath and a change of pace.
layout: Single line, full width, lots of space above and below.
motion: Line reveals once; or static.
avoid_when: More than two per page.

name: Brand lexicon
description: The brand's own words defined like a dictionary entry: term, pronunciation, meaning, use in a sentence.
layout: Dictionary layout, term in display face, definition in body.
motion: Entries expand in place.
avoid_when: Brands without distinctive vocabulary.

name: Build-up scrollytelling
tags: build|assemble|construction|how it is made|process|step by step|sticky|scrollytelling|building
description: A sticky visual assembles or changes step by step while short text steps scroll past; the reader watches the thing get made.
layout: Sticky stage (55-60%) beside or behind 3-6 text steps; mobile pins the stage on top.
motion: Scene verbs (drop, grow, light, draw) per step, scrubbed or played per step.
avoid_when: Processes with fewer than three meaningful visual changes; dense app screens.

name: Process as a path
description: The process drawn as a route through stations; each station is a step with one sentence and one visual.
layout: Winding or straight SVG path spanning the section, stations anchored along it.
motion: Path draws with scroll, a marker travels, stations light up.
avoid_when: Non-linear processes (use a diagram or tabs).

name: Diagram that builds
description: A system diagram builds node by node while connectors draw between them, each step explained beside it.
layout: Sticky SVG diagram beside text steps; on mobile the diagram becomes a vertical flow.
motion: Nodes pop in and connectors draw per step.
avoid_when: Systems too complex for 6-8 nodes (link to docs instead).

name: Under the hood
description: Zooms from the whole product into one mechanism or detail that makes it different, then explains it.
layout: Pinned full-viewport scene; explanation appears once the zoom settles.
motion: Scale-through zoom scrubbed by scroll.
avoid_when: Low-end devices as the main audience; products without an interesting interior.

name: A day in the life
description: Follows a customer or maker through one day; the light and a clock advance as the sections pass.
layout: Sticky sky or clock stage with time-stamped text steps; palette warms and cools with the hour.
motion: Scrubbed sun arc and color shift between steps.
avoid_when: Products used for a moment, not across a day.

name: Ingredients to outcome
description: Named inputs (ingredients, materials, data sources) travel into the center and combine into the finished outcome.
layout: Inputs arranged around a central stage; outcome revealed in the center.
motion: Inputs move inward in sequence, outcome pops in.
avoid_when: Services whose inputs are abstract or confidential.

name: Try it here
description: A small working interaction (slider, calculator, configurator) that lets the visitor feel the product's value.
layout: One focused control panel beside a live result; no fake UI.
motion: Result updates with a short state morph; nothing autoplays.
avoid_when: When the real product can't be simulated honestly.

name: One long comparison
description: Replaces feature cards with one long, readable comparison table: rows of real attributes, one column per option.
layout: Full-width table with sticky header row and first column; mobile swaps to stacked rows.
motion: Rows appear immediately; only the recommended column highlights once.
avoid_when: Fewer than two options or fewer than five attributes.

name: Exploded anatomy
description: The product separates into labelled layers so the reader sees what it is made of and why each part matters.
layout: Centered product stage, labels on alternating sides with leader lines; text steps optional.
motion: Parts move apart along one axis, labels fade in; reverses on scroll-up.
avoid_when: Products that are a single material or purely digital.

name: Product orbit
description: The product turns or unboxes as you scroll, stopping at angles where a short caption explains a detail.
layout: Pinned canvas stage with captions appearing at set angles.
motion: Canvas image-sequence scrubbed by scroll.
avoid_when: No render or photo sequence available.

name: One brand world
description: One persistent scene stays behind the whole page; each section is a new camera position or state of the same world.
layout: Fixed full-bleed canvas behind short DOM sections; only 3-4 stops.
motion: Camera moves between stops scrubbed by scroll; DOM copy fades per stop.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive audiences; no 3D budget; content-heavy sites.

name: Index of work
description: Projects as a dense typographic index; hovering a row shows its image, clicking opens the case study.
layout: Full-width rows: name, client, year, discipline; image preview follows the cursor on desktop.
motion: Preview clip-reveals on hover; route transition into the project.
avoid_when: Fewer than six projects (use large case cards instead).

name: Catalogue as index
description: Products as a typographic index with filters; hovering previews, selecting opens the product with a shared-element morph.
layout: Rows or tight grid with name, detail, price; filters as a sticky bar.
motion: Filter changes morph with view transitions.
avoid_when: Visual-first products where images must lead (use a grid).

name: Collection rail
description: A season's collection or lineup moves sideways in a pinned rail with large images and small captions.
layout: Pinned horizontal track of panels; native swipe with snap on mobile.
motion: Horizontal pin scrubbed by scroll.
avoid_when: Fewer than four items.

name: Drift gallery
description: Scattered images drift at different speeds and open full-screen on click, like a moodboard you walk past.
layout: Loose asymmetric placement on desktop, simple two-column grid on mobile.
motion: Per-image parallax; expand with a shared-element transition; no velocity distortion on mobile.
avoid_when: Product catalogues where comparison matters.

name: Chart that tells the story
description: A chart draws point by point while the text explains what each change means, ending on the key result.
layout: Sticky chart stage with annotated steps; axis and source visible.
motion: Line draws per step, annotations appear at their data points.
avoid_when: No real data or data that can't be published.

name: Case study chapters
description: One client story told as three or four chapters (situation, approach, result) with real numbers and images.
layout: Pinned chapters with a progress rail, or sticky stacked cards.
motion: Chapter transitions (fade, wipe) scrubbed by scroll.
avoid_when: No client permission to publish details.

name: Voices montage
description: Real customers speak one at a time over their own photo, like a documentary montage, instead of a card carousel.
layout: Pinned full-bleed portrait with one quote and name; progress dots.
motion: Crossfade between voices with scroll; no autoplay.
avoid_when: No real, approved quotes (mark samples as placeholders).

name: Field log
description: Dated entries like a site logbook show steady work and progress; a sticky date rail tracks where you are.
layout: Sticky date column left, entries right, photos inline at fixed ratios.
motion: Date rail highlights the current entry; entries static.
avoid_when: Brands with infrequent updates.

name: The ledger
description: Key numbers set like a financial statement with tabular figures and sources, not floating stat cards.
layout: Ruled table or two-column ledger; numbers right-aligned in tabular numerals.
motion: Numbers count once when reached.
avoid_when: Vanity metrics with no source.

name: Press mastheads
description: Real press coverage shown as mastheads with the actual headline, not a grey logo strip.
layout: Row or column of masthead plus headline and date, linked to the article.
motion: Static, or a slow pausable marquee when there are many.
avoid_when: No real coverage.

name: Mixed proof grid
description: A grid of different tile types (quote, number, image, short clip) summarising proof; tiles differ in size and content.
layout: Asymmetric grid with 4-7 tiles of different kinds, never identical cards.
motion: One staggered group entrance.
avoid_when: When used as the default features block; more than seven tiles.

name: Map journey
description: A route draws across a stylised map between the places that matter (farms, studios, stores), with a stop per story beat.
layout: Sticky map stage with text stops, or a full-width map with inline labels.
motion: Route draws with scroll, a marker travels, stops activate.
avoid_when: Single-location businesses (use place-panorama).

name: Place panorama
description: A wide panorama of the place (venue, landscape, workshop) that pans sideways as you scroll down.
layout: Pinned full-bleed wide image or illustration with captions anchored to spots.
motion: Horizontal pan scrubbed by scroll with gentle depth layers.
avoid_when: No wide imagery; mobile-only audiences (use a native swipe rail).

name: Visit us
description: Practical visit information set with character: hours, address, a small map, and what to expect on arrival.
layout: Two columns: facts and a map or photo; hours in a clear table.
motion: None beyond focus and hover states.
avoid_when: Online-only businesses.

name: Crew portraits
description: The team as portraits of varied sizes with roles and one human detail each, not a uniform headshot grid.
layout: Asymmetric grid of portraits at mixed sizes, names set in the display face.
motion: Portraits clip-reveal once in reading order.
avoid_when: Large organisations (show leadership plus a link) or when staff prefer privacy.

name: Hands at work
description: Close-up loops of hands doing the work, each with a one-line caption about the skill involved.
layout: Row or grid of short muted loops at fixed ratio with captions; pause control.
motion: Loops play only in view and stop under reduced motion.
avoid_when: Brands without real footage of their work.

name: Community wall
description: A mosaic of real community photos or posts showing who the brand is for.
layout: Masonry or tight grid with mixed ratios; source handles visible.
motion: Tiles fade in as a staggered group once.
avoid_when: No real community content or no permission.

name: Before and after
description: The same subject before and after the brand's work, revealed by a wipe as you scroll, with a manual slider.
layout: Full-width image pair at identical framing; caption with what changed.
motion: Clip-path wipe scrubbed by scroll plus range input.
avoid_when: Results that can't be shown honestly with photographs.

name: Metamorphosis
description: One visual changes shape across steps (seed to tree, sketch to building, raw to refined) as the text explains each stage.
layout: Sticky stage beside text steps; each stage is a clear state.
motion: Scene parts grow, move and fade per step.
avoid_when: When the stages are not visually distinct.

name: Invitation
description: A personal invitation in the brand's voice with one action and a sentence on what happens next, instead of a gradient CTA banner.
layout: Offset column with the ask, one primary button, the next-step line underneath.
motion: Primary button gets the page's one delight effect at most.
avoid_when: Never skip an ask entirely; vary its form instead.

name: Expanding finale
description: A small brand shape grows to fill the screen at the end of the page, revealing the closing line and one action.
layout: Pinned final section; closing line centered or offset inside the grown shape.
motion: Scrubbed clip-path circle or scale; static full shape under reduced motion.
avoid_when: Pages that end on practical information (hours, forms).

name: Guided pricing
description: Two or three questions lead to the right plan, then show its price and what's included.
layout: Question steps then one recommended plan card beside the full plan table link.
motion: Step changes morph in place.
avoid_when: Simple single-price products (just state the price).

name: Inline booking
description: The booking or inquiry form sits in the page flow as the final chapter, short and step-by-step.
layout: Two to four steps with progress; summary beside the form on desktop.
motion: Step changes slide in the direction of travel.
avoid_when: Complex purchases needing a sales call first.

name: Closing letter
description: The page ends the way it began, with a short signed note from the founder or team, closing the story loop.
layout: Narrow column mirroring the opening letter, with signature.
motion: Signature draws once.
avoid_when: When the page did not open with a personal voice.

name: Next chapter footer
description: The footer becomes a large link to the next page of the story, so the site reads as chapters rather than dead ends.
layout: Full-width block with the next chapter's title in display size and a preview image.
motion: Hover preview, then a page transition into the next chapter.
avoid_when: Single-page sites.

name: FAQ as dialogue
description: Questions and answers laid out as a conversation in the brand's voice rather than a grey accordion.
layout: Alternating question and answer blocks, or native details elements styled as dialogue.
motion: Answers expand in place; no autoplaying chat.
avoid_when: Long support FAQs (use a help center).
